Nano Banana refers to four distinct models available in the Gemini API: Nano Banana 2 Lite (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image), Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image), Nano Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image) and Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image).

оговорки.текст_en: "Nano Banana" names Google's family of image generation and editing models built on Gemini: image-generating models (like gemini-3.1-flash-image) are also known as the "Nano Banana" models.
Codelab (content 'as of February 2026'): 'Nano Banana refers to two distinct models available in the Gemini API: Nano Banana and Nano Banana Pro' — older, narrower count.

Nano Banana models are described as advanced image generation and editing models that use real-world knowledge and deep reasoning capabilities to deliver precise, rich visual results (Cloud blog, March 2026).
Google AI site navigation lists Nano Banana among Google DeepMind models as the model to create and edit detailed images.
The Provisioned Throughput page calls the Gemini 3 Image models as a whole 'Nano Banana' ('Gemini 3 Image (also known as Nano Banana) models').

On the Gemini API page 'Gemini 3 image models' covers Pro, 3.1 Flash and 3.1 Flash Lite, but several capabilities listed under that phrase then exclude Lite (2K/4K, Google Search grounding) — statements about 'Gemini 3 image models' must be read with model-specific exceptions.
Vertex AI release notes never use the name 'Nano Banana'; Gemini image models are always called 'Gemini <version> Flash Image' plus the model ID.
Firebase: "All Imagen models shut down on August 17, 2026. As a replacement, you can … migrate your apps to use Gemini 3.x Image models (the "Nano Banana" models)."

After Pro's launch it was presented as "the newest version of our viral image generation model" (Mixboard tip, 2025-12-19) and "The most recent version of Gemini's image generation is Nano Banana Pro" (android.com, 2025-12-16) — dated statements.
Workspace Updates (2026-02-26): "Nano Banana 2, which replaces our previous Nano Banana model …".
Later pages use "our latest Nano Banana model" without a version: Google Pics (I/O, 2026-05-20).
The I/O 2026 page never gives a version or id for Nano Banana (extractor inference).

Search (2026-07-14): the link on "our latest Nano Banana model" targets the Nano Banana 2 Lite announcement; the text does not name the version (link from html; that Lite is used is an extractor hypothesis).
Flow model card "Nano Banana": "Powerful image generation and precise editing control."; "Our image models excel at subject consistency, text rendering, enhanced reasoning, and much more."
Agent Platform docs navigation includes a page titled "Provisioned Throughput for Gemini 3 (Nano Banana) models" (from page chrome, extractor inference).

ядра.подтема: Предшественник: нативная генерация в Gemini 2.0 Flash
ядра.ядро_en: When we first launched native image generation in Gemini 2.0 Flash earlier this year, you told us you loved its low latency, cost-effectiveness, and ease of use. But you also gave us feedback that you needed higher-quality images and more powerful creative control.

модели_различия.текст_en: 2.5 Flash Image was created in response to requests for quality and control
Gemini 2.0 Flash native image generation: trusted testers 2024-12 → experimental 2025-03-12 (gemini-2.0-flash-exp) → preview 2025-05-07 (gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation)
Gemini 2.0 Flash native image generation (gemini-2.0-flash-exp); the Gemini 2.5 report refers to two 2025 Google blog posts for details

оговорки.текст_en: Gemini 2.0 Flash combines multimodal input, enhanced reasoning, and natural language understanding to create images.

Timeline: "In December we first introduced native image output in Gemini 2.0 Flash to trusted testers. Today [2025-03-12], we're making it available for developer experimentation across all regions currently supported by Google AI Studio."; "In March 2025, we released an experimental version of Gemini 2.0 Flash Native Image Generation."; "Image Generation capabilities are now available in preview with Gemini 2.0 Flash" (2025-05-07).
Preview vs experimental: "Better visual quality", "More accurate text rendering", "Significantly reduced filter block rates" (all "vs experimental version").
These quality claims are relative to the earlier experimental version of the same model, not to other models (extractor inference).

2.0 Flash claims: "Internal benchmarks show that 2.0 Flash has stronger rendering compared to leading competitive models"; "leverages world knowledge and enhanced reasoning to create the right image"; "add text and image generation with just a single model … finalize a production-ready version soon."
Gemini 2.5 technical report (~June 2025): only Gemini 2.0 Flash lists Image as an output modality, "*currently limited to Experimental or Preview"; Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro list Text and Audio only.
The report predates Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and does not mention it (extractor inference).
The Next.js quickstart code targets gemini-2.0-flash-exp; its parameters are tied to that experimental model (extractor inference).

For details on Gemini 2.0 Flash native image generation the Gemini 2.5 report points to two Google blog posts: K. Kampf and N. Brichtova, "Experiment with Gemini 2.0 Flash native image generation" (2025), and D. Sharon, "Upload and edit your images directly in the Gemini app" (2025).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: old code or an example uses gemini-2.0-flash-exp / gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation, or a 2025 article talks about "native image output"; you need to explain where Nano Banana gets its world knowledge and conversational editing (the image is a native output of the language model)
ядра.не_применяется_когда: the current Nano Banana models (Pro, 2, 2 Lite); choosing a model today: 2.0 Flash was the experimental predecessor; Pro/NB2/Lite are current

ядра.подтема: карта выбора модели (Model selection)
ядра.ядро_en: Model selection: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) should be your go-to image generation model, as the best all around performance and intelligence to cost and latency balance; Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image (Nano Banana 2 Lite) is the most efficient model in the image generation family, offering ultra-low latency and cost-effective image generation and editing; Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro) is designed for professional asset production and complex instructions (Google Search grounding, default 'Thinking', up to 4K); Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana) is designed for speed and efficiency, optimized for high-volume, low-latency tasks, at 1024px.

части.текст_en: NB2 is the default (go-to): balance of quality/intelligence with cost and latency
Lite is the most efficient: ultra-low latency and cost
Pro is for professional assets and complex instructions: Search grounding, Thinking, up to 4K
NB 2.5: speed/volume, 1024px; legacy
[model: lite] Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image): Built for speed. Optimized for near-real-time, high-volume workflows where ultra-low latency is critical.
[model: nb2] Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image): The generalist workhorse. Delivers high quality at a lower latency, offering the best balance of performance and cost.

[model: pro] Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image): Optimized for complex, professional use cases. It provides the most robust control and advanced reasoning for tasks where accuracy is more important than speed.
[model: nb25] Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image): Our legacy model. We recommend upgrading to Nano Banana 2 Lite for better quality, faster speeds and lower costs.

оговорки.текст_en: Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image): Built for speed. Optimized for near-real-time, high-volume workflows where ultra-low latency is critical. Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image): The generalist workhorse. Delivers high quality at a lower latency, offering the best balance of performance and cost. Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image): Optimized for complex, professional use cases. It provides the most robust control and advanced reasoning for tasks where accuracy is more important than speed. Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image): Our legacy model. We recommend upgrading to Nano Banana 2 Lite for better quality, faster speeds and lower costs.
Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is optimized for speed and high-volume use-cases, and Gemini 3 Pro Image is optimized for professional asset production.
Nano Banana Pro is 'our highest quality image generation model', and Nano Banana 2 is 'the high-volume, high-efficiency, lower price-point equivalent'.
Agent skill file ladder by description: high-quality (Pro), fast/efficient (NB2), ultra-fast (Lite).

Models index positions: Pro — professional design engine with a reasoning core; NB2 — high-efficiency production scale; Lite — efficiency specialist; NB 2.5 — fast creative workflows, access limited to prior users.

Vertex catalog differentiates only by short lists: Pro alone credited with reasoning-enhanced composition, legible text and up to 14 reference inputs; NB2 and NB 2.5 share identical wording; Lite — high-volume, latency-sensitive.

Codelab (Feb 2026): Nano Banana (Gemini Flash Image) — speed and efficiency, high-volume, low-latency; Nano Banana Pro (Gemini Pro Image) — professional asset production, advanced reasoning for complex instructions and high-fidelity text.

Cookbook: "The fastest and most cost-effective image generation model. It includes a free tier, making it ideal for high-throughput generation, rapid prototyping, and interactive applications." Firebase: "Ultra-low latency and cost-effective image generation and editing model, designed for high-volume interactive use cases."

Cookbook: "The standard, highly versatile image model. It balances speed, quality, wide aspect ratios (from 1:8 to 8:1), Google Search grounding, image grounding, and multimodal video-to-image inputs." Firebase: "Powerful, high-efficiency image generation and editing model, optimized for speed and high-volume use cases."

Cookbook: "The flagship model with advanced reasoning (thinking), 4K resolution, complex typography rendering, and high-fidelity multi-image composition." Firebase: "State-of-the-art image generation and editing model for highly contextual native image creation."
The DeepMind hub positions the three current models on a quality-to-speed/cost ladder (qualitative only, no numbers) (extractor inference).

Extractor's one-line rule from this map: choose by the primary constraint — Lite when speed/cost/volume dominate, NB2 as the balance, Pro when accuracy and control matter more than speed; 2.5 is legacy ("default" for NB2 is the extractor's shorthand for "generalist workhorse") (extractor inference).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: no generation model is set; the task shows whether quality/text/facts matter most (Pro), balance (NB2) or speed/price/volume (Lite); the task requires choosing a model and the main constraint is visible: speed/volume (hundreds of drafts, real time), balance of quality and price, or accuracy and control of a complex professional scene
ядра.не_применяется_когда: the model is fixed by the client or the platform; a feature is needed that the chosen model lacks (see the matrix); the model is already set by a product (Gemini app, Workspace), where the choice goes through the model switch

ядра.ядро_en: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) should be your go-to image generation model, as the best all around performance and intelligence to cost and latency balance. It serves as the most versatile model, generalist workhorse model for all tasks, balancing speed with state-of-the-art 4K generation, world knowledge, and reliable text rendering, excelling at multiple reference image processing and consistency.

модели_различия.текст_en: NB2 is the "high-efficiency counterpart" to Pro
default; "Pro-level at Flash speed" (blog)
NB2 and NB 2.5 are described identically in the Vertex catalog (E-54-1/E-54-5)

оговорки.текст_en: Nano Banana 2 provides high-quality image generation and conversational editing at a mainstream price point and low latency; it serves as the high-efficiency counterpart to Gemini 3 Pro Image, optimized for speed and high-volume developer use cases.
Models index: 'High-efficiency production-scale visual creation, combining the intelligence of the Gemini 3 series with lightning-fast generation speeds.'

Vertex card: optimized for image understanding and generation and offers a balance of price and performance; Vertex catalog: production-ready assets, turn-based conversational editing, multi-image fusion and character consistency.
Cloud blogs: Nano Banana 2 delivers 'Pro-level generation and editing at Flash speed', making Nano Banana Pro's quality, reasoning and world knowledge more accessible.
Improved image quality and consistency; improved pricing and latency — comparison base not named.
Enterprise framing: first-class access on Agent Platform, positioned to generate high-fidelity user interfaces and visual assets.
Cookbook: 'the standard, highly versatile image model' with wide aspect ratios (1:8 to 8:1), Google Search grounding, image grounding and video-to-image inputs.

ядра.не_применяется_когда: studio-grade accuracy of text or fact-based infographics is needed (→ Pro), or a rough high-volume stream with minimal latency (→ Lite)

ядра.ядро_en: Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro), is designed to tackle the most challenging image generation by incorporating state-of-the-art reasoning capabilities. It's the best model for complex and multi-turn image generation and editing, having improved accuracy and enhanced image quality.

модели_различия.текст_en: best for complex and multi-turn generation and editing; studio-quality precision and control; state-of-the-art reasoning
premium: complex tasks, world knowledge, localization, brand consistency, precise control

оговорки.текст_en: Nano Banana Pro is best for complex graphic design, high-fidelity product mockups, and factual data visualizations that require accurate text rendering and real-world grounding via Google Search.

Hub: "Built on Gemini 3. Create and edit images with studio-quality levels of precision and control"; developer post: "a higher-fidelity model built on Gemini 3 Pro for developers to access studio-quality image generation."

Firebase: "State-of-the-art image generation and editing model for highly contextual native image creation."; cookbook: "The flagship model with advanced reasoning (thinking), 4K resolution, complex typography rendering, and high-fidelity multi-image composition."

Workspace: "giving more complex and sophisticated outputs and advanced, precise control"; "Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) and Veo 3.1, Google's state-of-the-art image and video generation models".
Skills lab: "a powerful, generalist multimodal model that offers state-of-the-art image generation and conversational image editing capabilities."

Dated superlatives (Nov–Dec 2025): "our most advanced image model to date", "Google's most advanced model for image generation", "our latest Gemini Image model", "the newest version of our viral image generation model", "Google's most advanced image-generation model", "The most recent version of Gemini's image generation".
Nano Banana Pro "uses Gemini 3 Pro to better understand what you want to visualize and generate it with higher precision, more depth and nuance and incredible detail."

Across surfaces the "Where to use" page frames Pro's advantage as precision and control (intent via Gemini 3 Pro, precise generation in Vids, frames/scenes and text rendering in Flow) (extractor inference).

Gemini API model list: 'The premium choice for the most complex visual tasks, offering the highest level of world knowledge, advanced localization, accurate brand consistency, and precision creative control'; Model selection: designed for professional asset production and complex instructions (Google Search grounding, default 'Thinking', up to 4K).

Vertex: the best model for complex and multi-turn image generation and editing, with improved accuracy and enhanced image quality; designed to tackle the most challenging image generation by incorporating state-of-the-art reasoning.

Models index: 'a professional design engine with a reasoning core for studio-quality 4K visuals, complex layouts, and precise text rendering'; 'state-of-the-art image generation and editing for highly contextual native image creation'.
Vertex catalog: high-fidelity image generation with reasoning-enhanced composition, legible text rendering and complex multi-turn editing.
Cookbook: 'The flagship model with advanced reasoning (thinking), 4K resolution, complex typography rendering, and high-fidelity multi-image composition.'
What sets it apart is its ability to 'think' before it creates; framed as part of a reasoning-plus-multimodal-output stack; can create high-fidelity images, voxel art and game assets (Dec 2025).
Expect higher latency when using this model compared to Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana) as a result of the more advanced capabilities.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: the task is complex: many objects or characters, multi-turn editing, precise composition, studio-like result for professional use; the task has a complex composition/layout, corporate style and brand consistency, localization, factual infographics, precise text, 4K for print; price and latency are secondary
ядра.не_применяется_когда: quick drafts and high-volume generation (Lite, NB2); high-volume/fast generation, drafts, video input in the Gemini API (Pro does not support it), 512px output is needed

оговорки.текст_en: Nano Banana Pro is the best model for creating images with correctly rendered and legible text directly in the image, whether you’re looking for a short tagline, or a long paragraph.
Pro is credited with precise text rendering, legible text rendering, complex typography rendering and high-fidelity text through advanced reasoning.
Nano Banana 2 balances speed with state-of-the-art 4K generation, world knowledge, and reliable text rendering.
Nano Banana 2 Lite is pitched for drafts: rough visualizations and draft typography.
Vertex 'When to use Gemini or Imagen' page recommends Imagen 4 for generating advanced spelling or typography — Imagen endpoints are discontinued (see Imagen cores).

Developer post: "Gemini 3 Pro Image offers a significant leap forward from 2.5 Flash Image … It excels in handling logic and language, and delivers state-of-the-art text rendering, producing clear, accurate text integrated in your images."
Prompt-tips post: Nano Banana Pro "includes advancements in text rendering, world knowledge, creative controls and more"; cookbook: "complex typography rendering".
NB2 developer post: "Nano Banana 2 delivers an upgrade from previous Flash image models with more reliable text rendering." (comparison with earlier Flash models, not with Pro)
Gemini Apps help: NB2 "balances speed with higher image quality, more world knowledge, and reliable text rendering"; Pro has "advanced text and language capabilities".
Workspace FAQ: "Some capabilities available only with Nano Banana Pro (such as infographics) might not be available." (on the fallback model)

NB2 page charts: Gemini 3 Pro Image renders short and long text with fewer errors than NB2; long text in non-Latin scripts is weak for most models incl. NB2 (extractor inference; see the linked NB2 benchmark core).

Lite card lists localized text and clear poster text as intended uses, but has no text-rendering results row, Text Editing is among its weakest rows, and small/long text is a known limitation — text-heavy work is a risk area (extractor inference).
Firebase generate-images page: in-image text for Gemini 2.5 Flash Image — English only (per-model summary, extractor inference).
Agent Platform limitations: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image — 5 recommended languages; Gemini 3 Pro Image — 15 languages; NB2 and Lite not covered (extractor inference).

приёмы.текст_en: In the Gemini app, paid subscribers can regenerate an image with Nano Banana Pro: "Nano Banana Pro can provide additional detail, especially for images that use text rendering or for infographics."

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: the prompt contains captions, headlines, labels, an infographic, a menu/poster/label with text, a comic or a storyboard with dialogue; the prompt contains in-image text: a slogan, a headline, a paragraph, a menu, a poster, an infographic, localized text
ядра.не_применяется_когда: there is no in-image text or it does not matter; a draft where the text will be replaced later; there is no in-image text, or speed and price matter more than the accuracy of the lettering
ядра.магнит_причина: cautious negation: "(such as infographics) might not be available" on the fallback model

термины.значение_en: rendering of in-image lettering: correctness and legibility
an image with data and text; in Workspace it is called a capability available "only with Nano Banana Pro"

оговорки.текст_en: Our fastest, most efficient Gemini Image model. Built to deliver high-speed generation and editing at our lowest cost yet.

'Our fastest and cheapest Gemini image model, engineered for velocity and scale where speed and cost are the primary operational constraints'; Vertex: 'fastest image generation model, enabling rapid creation and iteration'; blog: 'the fastest and most cost-efficient image generation and editing model in the Nano Banana family'.

Described across pages as the efficiency specialist of the image generation family, offering ultra-low latency and cost-effective image generation and editing; designed for high-volume interactive / latency-sensitive workloads.
Cookbook: 'The fastest and most cost-effective image generation model. It includes a free tier, making it ideal for high-throughput generation, rapid prototyping, and interactive applications.'
Uses world knowledge to quickly draft accurate contextual scenes, rough data visualizations and location-specific mockups.
Google claims some of the best price-performance among market-leading frontier models (marketing, no figures).
Vertex card: only 1K output, 4,096 output tokens, 65,536 input tokens, no grounding, 14 aspect ratios; Gemini API card: framed around speed and cost at 1K only.
Vertex notebook requests IMAGE only (never TEXT) and its one thinking example uses MINIMAL.

Launch blog: "Our fastest, most cost-efficient image model in the Nano Banana family yet, built for high throughput, speed and scale."; June recap: "our fastest and most cost-efficient Gemini Image model yet".
Latency: "Delivers text-to-image outputs in 4 seconds." (measurement conditions not stated)

Lite page: "Our most efficient model to date, Nano Banana 2 Lite offers the best balance of quality and speed. From prompt adherence to details and control, see how it performs alongside our premier Nano Banana 2 model."
"Generate thousands of images at a fraction of the cost of heavier production models."
Firebase: "Ultra-low latency and cost-effective image generation and editing model, designed for high-volume interactive use cases."
Gemini Apps: used when the Gemini model is set to Flash-Lite; "It is optimized for speed. It is ideal for quick images and basic ideas."

Gemini Apps help (via E-208-20, outside this part): Lite "isn’t designed for multiple image references or for multiple edits" → for multi-reference or multi-step editing use Flash/Pro (extractor inference).
The June 2026 recap positions Lite only by speed and cost, with no quality, resolution, pricing or API-ID details (extractor inference).

"Nano Banana 2 Lite (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image) is designed for rapid ideation and high-velocity developer pipelines where speed and cost are the primary constraints."
"This [4 s latency] makes it ideal for interactive prototyping and rapid visual drafting."
"A cost-efficient choice for developers focused on drafting, ideating, managing operational budgets or low-bandwidth usage."
"From rapid prototyping to populating real-time apps"; "Built for rapid-fire visual exploration."; "Explore, iterate, and keep your workflow moving with dramatically reduced latency."

ядра.ядро_en: Although Nano Banana image generation models are recommended for most use cases, you can also explore dedicated image generation models. Gemini Image is the default recommendation: unparalleled flexibility, contextual understanding, and mask-free editing; uniquely capable of multi-turn conversational editing. We recommend Gemini as a starting point for generating images.

модели_различия.текст_en: Imagen 4 / 4 Ultra: advice about quality, photorealism, styles, logos, typography, speed; Imagen is turned off / shut down
"Gemini Image" without a version is the default: flexibility, context, mask-free editing, multi-turn editing, interleaved text and images, composing from several images

оговорки.текст_en: Gemini Image is recommended for interleaved text and image generation and for combining creative elements from multiple images with a single prompt; advanced multi-turn editing is a key strength of Gemini models.

оговорки.текст_en: Search grounding is supported on `gemini-3.1-flash-image` and `gemini-3-pro-image-preview`.
Lite is not named for Google Search grounding on the Gemini API page, has no grounding pricing row, and its Vertex card lists no grounding.
Gemini 2.5 Flash Image card: knowledge cutoff June 2025, Search grounding not supported (table row, per extractor note).
Pro features real-world grounding using Google Search; best for factual data visualizations that require real-world grounding via Google Search.
Via the OpenAI compatibility layer, search grounding for images is documented only for gemini-3-pro-image-preview; gemini-2.5-flash-image cannot be grounded there.

NB2: "integrated image-search grounding" is named as its distinguishing trait; cookbook: "Google Search grounding, image grounding".
Agent Platform card for Pro: Grounding with Google Search supported as a tool (extractor summary).
Gemini 2.5 Flash Image in Firebase: no tools — function calling, code execution, URL context, grounding with Google Search or Maps (icons, extractor inference).
From 2.5 to 3.x, Google Search grounding was added for Pro and Flash (extractor inference).
Differences summary: Pro and NB2 — Google Search grounding; Lite — none (extractor summary).
NB2 card reports a "(Thinking + Text Search + Image Search)" column alongside plain NB2.
Pro card: all Gemini 3 Pro Image scores are for "(Search On)"; no search-off results (extractor).

ядра.ядро_en: A 'deprecation' is the announcement that we no longer provide support for a model, and that it will be 'shut down' in the near future. Once a model is 'shutdown', it is completely turned off, and the endpoint is no longer available. The shutdown dates listed in the table indicate the earliest possible dates on which a model might be retired; we will communicate the exact shutdown date to users with advance notice.

оговорки.текст_en: ModelStatus stages: EXPERIMENTAL (experimental purposes only), PREVIEW (more mature than experimental), STABLE (ready for production), LEGACY (on the path to deprecation; only existing customers), RETIRED (cannot be used).
Deprecation announcements are made on the Release notes page; already-shutdown models are shown with gray backgrounds in the deprecations tables.
Rate limits are more restricted for experimental and preview models; limits vary by model and some apply only to specific models; each image generation model may have its own limits.
Agent Platform model cards state retirement as a floor ('... or later'); retired preview models 'are no longer accessible'.

On the 2026-09-23 deprecations page several image-model rows whose earliest shutdown date has passed (Gemini 3 image previews June 25, 2026; imagen-4.0-*-001 August 17, 2026) are not grayed — such IDs may still respond but can be turned off at any time.
Vertex notice periods: preview endpoints ~1 month (or ~7 weeks); GA/feature removals ~2.5–3 months.

оговорки.текст_en: "A stable model version is typically released with a retirement date, which indicates the last day that the model is available. After this date, the model is no longer accessible or supported by Google. Most stable models are available for 12 months after their release date (even if a replacement model is released)."

"For the Agent Platform Gemini API (formerly Vertex AI), some stable models only have short-term availability, which means that they may be shut down (retired) as early as 45 days after a replacement model is released." Firebase marks gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image as a short-term availability model.

"Preview versions have new capabilities and are considered not stable. These models are not recommended for production use, come with more restrictive rate limits, and may have billing requirements. These models are shut down (retired) within a few weeks or months after their associated stable version is released."

Cloud blogs: GA on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform May 28, 2026; in Dec 2025 Pro was 'the newest iteration in its media generation series'.
The Gemini API model card still shows 'Latest update: November 2025' (preview-era date).
Agent Platform May 6, 2026 preview upgrades (4K, 1 thought image, 512 size); 4K GA for both on August 31, 2026.

ядра.ядро_en: Gemini 2.5 Image Preview (gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview) launched on August 26, 2025; Gemini 2.5 Flash Image became generally available on October 2, 2025; the preview was shut down on January 15, 2026. Gemini API: gemini-2.5-flash-image is deprecated and will be shut down on October 2, 2026. Agent Platform: deprecated and scheduled for retirement on March 15, 2027 (extended from October 2, 2026). Disputed for the Gemini API: a September 18, 2026 note says the 2.5 models 'are not deprecated and will continue to be served until further notice' (access limited to past users).

модели_различия.текст_en: preview 2025-08-26 → GA 2025-10-02 → preview off 2026-01-15 → API: deprecated, shutdown 2026-10-02 (disputed by "not deprecated") → Vertex: retirement 2027-03-15
deprecated; new projects cannot start; shutdown 2026-10-02 (Firebase)

оговорки.текст_en: Warning: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (gemini-2.5-flash-image) will shut down on October 02, 2026.
Cloud blogs: preview on Vertex AI announced Aug 26, 2025; GA on Vertex AI Oct 2, 2025 ('production ready'); in Sept 2025 Nano Banana = Gemini 2.5 Flash Image Preview.
Gemini API card: 'Deprecated: gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview'; 'Latest update: October 2025'.
As of June 2026 Google calls the original Nano Banana 'our legacy model'; the Gemini API page calls it 'the legacy pioneer of the Nano Banana series'.
Gemini Enterprise app: Nano Banana (2.5) GA Oct 2, 2025 in Global/EU/US; its fate after the new models' GA is not described there.

Vertex AI release notes record no deprecation of gemini-2.5-flash-image; it is the named replacement for Imagen endpoints (entries up to 2026-03-24). The Agent Platform card stresses deprecation twice with the same date.
Banner on Firebase AI Logic pages: "Gemini 2.5 models will shut down in October 2026 (and new projects cannot start using them)."
"Image-generating Gemini 2.5 models support this capability, but they're all deprecated."

Name table: gemini-2.5-flash-image — Stable version of Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (aka "Nano Banana"), released 2025-10-02, shutdown 2026-10-02; "Requires the pay-as-you-go Blaze pricing plan regardless of your Gemini API provider."
"The following are active, but previous generation models. We recommend using one of the latest models instead when possible."
Google blog (2026-06-30): "Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image): Our legacy model."

The prompt-design page's only image-specific directives are operational: 2.5 shutdown in October 2026 with gemini-3.1-flash-image as a named replacement, and App Check enforcement from November 2, 2026 (extractor inference).

June 24, 2025: Imagen 1 and 2, image captioning and VQA deprecated; removal of imagegeneration@002/@005/@006 on September 24, 2025.

Imagen 3: imagen-3.0-generate-001 and fast-generate-001 (low latency) GA for approved users July 31, 2024, for all users Dec 10, 2024; imagen-3.0-capability (customization) for approved users; imagen-3.0-generate-002 available Jan 29, 2025.

Imagen 4: Generate Preview 05-20 and Ultra Generate Experimental 05-20 (May 20, 2025); updated to -preview-06-06 (June 11, 2025; migrate from 05-20 before 2025-07-07); GA Generate / Fast Generate / Ultra Generate (Aug 14, 2025); previews to be removed Nov 30, 2025 (source text: 'November 30, 2025, 2025').

ядра.подтема: Бенчмарки карточки Gemini 3 Pro Image (ноябрь 2025)
ядра.ядро_en: Results: Gemini 3 Pro Image demonstrated strong performance and leads on Elo score across all new capabilities and regression sets. It leads with significant margins in complex tasks, e.g. multi-character, chart and text editing. It improves substantially in style compared to Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.

модели_различия.текст_en: all scores are for the "Search On" configuration; leader in all 16 rows
baseline for comparison (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image)
GPT-Image 1, Seedream v4 4k, Flux Pro Kontext Max

оговорки.текст_en: Approach: human evaluations of several quality aspects, prompt sets in two categories; "Regression sets: popular use cases observed on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, to ensure Gemini 3 Pro Image does not show noticeable regression."

"Existing Capabilities: Text Rendering, Stylization, Multi-Turn, General Image Editing, Character Editing, Object/Environment Editing, Generate Text-to-Image and Regressions. New Capabilities: Multi character editing, Chart editing, Text editing, Factuality - Edu, Multi-input, Infographics, Doodle editing and Visual design."
Columns: Gemini 3 Pro Image (Search On) | Gemini 2.5 Flash Image | GPT-Image 1 | Seedream v4 4k | Flux Pro Kontext Max; all Pro numbers are for Search On, none with search off (extractor).

Pro is ahead of every compared model on all 16 rows; largest margins Multi character editing (+216), Chart editing (+215), Text editing (+201); smallest Visual design (+21), Stylization (+29), Regression sets (+42), Text Rendering (+48 over GPT-Image 1) (extractor inference; Text editing/Infographics rows are outside this part).
The General T2I row is broken across lines in the text; values were assigned to columns by position (extractor note).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: you need to justify choosing Pro over the original Nano Banana by task type (several characters, charts, text, multi-turn editing)
ядра.не_применяется_когда: comparing the numbers with other model cards or pages (benchmarks are compared only within one card; competitor sets, configurations and dates differ)

the Pro configuration with search enabled

ядра.подтема: Бенчмарки карточки Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (февраль 2026)
ядра.ядро_en: Eval Methodology: SxS human eval to get Elo across diverse T2I, Editing, and Multi-Turn. Single sided expert rating on subject-focused tasks on EDU tasks, GenExam. AutoRater on factuality, style diversity of non-natural images. [Results tables: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Thinking + Text Search + Image Search) | Gemini 3.1 Flash Image | Gemini 2.5 Flash Image ("Nano Banana") | Gemini 3 Pro Image ("Nano Banana Pro") | GPT-Image 1.5 | Seedream 5.0 Lite | Grok Imagine Image Pro]

модели_различия.текст_en: the "Nano Banana Pro" column
two columns: with Thinking + Text Search + Image Search and without
the "Nano Banana" column
GPT-Image 1.5, Seedream 5.0 Lite, Grok Imagine Image Pro

оговорки.текст_en: "Gemini 3.1 Flash Image was evaluated using the methodology below: Human evaluations of several different quality aspects of image generation were conducted. Prompt sets … in two broad categories".
"Regression sets: popular use cases observed on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image and Gemini 3 Pro Image, to ensure Gemini 3.1 Flash Image does not show noticeable regression."

"Capabilities / Benchmarks: T2I: General Text-to-Image, Text Rendering, Visual Design. Editing: General Image Editing, Stylization, Character Editing, Object/Environment Editing, Factuality, Infographics, Ink (doodle) based Editing, Multi-Image (Multi-Product Recontextualization, Multi-Character, etc.), Multi-Turn. Public benchmark: a subset of GenExam."

The Thinking + Text Search + Image Search configuration scores above plain NB2 on every row except Creative editing (1023 vs 1031); largest gain Infographics (Factuality) 1114 vs 1074 (extractor inference).

Gemini 3 Pro Image scores above both NB2 columns on Multi-Input (1-3) (1056) and Object/Environment Editing (1042) and ties the top on Stylization (1045), while NB2 leads Overall Preference and Visual Quality in text-to-image (extractor inference).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: you need to know where NB2 catches up with or overtakes Pro and how much better NB2 is than the original Nano Banana

Thinking vs No thinking: Thinking higher on most rows; No thinking higher on Social Media Trends - T2I (+26), Multi Character (up to 5) Editing (+14), Text Editing (+7) (extractor inference).

A competitor, GPT 2 Response API Low, has the top score on 11 of 13 rows; Hunyuan v3 leads Stylization, Gemini 3 Pro Image leads Multi Character (up to 5) Editing (1135); Lite (Thinking) outscores Pro only on General T2I and Visual Design (extractor inference).
i18n Text Rendering is in the methodology but has no results row; text-heavy work is a risk area for Lite (extractor inference).

словарь_терминов.значение_en: Name of Gemini's native image generation capabilities and of the family of Gemini image models (four models in the Gemini API); from 2025-08 to 2025-11 the name meant Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, and officially the bare name without a version still denotes gemini-2.5-flash-image; later it is the name of the family ("Nano Banana" models).

словарь_терминов.термин: Nano Banana Pro / Nano Banana 2 / Nano Banana 2 Lite
словарь_терминов.значение_en: Nano Banana Pro = Gemini 3 Pro Image (gemini-3-pro-image); Nano Banana 2 = Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (gemini-3.1-flash-image); Nano Banana 2 Lite = Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image).

словарь_терминов.термин: Gemini Image / Gemini Image models / Gemini 3 image models / Gemini 3 Image / Gemini 3.x Image / "Nano Banana" models
словарь_терминов.значение_en: The class of Gemini image-generating models: Pro, 3.1 Flash and (not always) 3.1 Flash-Lite; on the Vertex page 'When to use Gemini or Imagen', 'Gemini Image' means Gemini native image generation without a version.
The default model for image generation: Nano Banana 2.
Role of Lite: ultra-low latency and cost.
The purpose of Pro.

Model stages: STABLE (GA) is ready for production, usually for 12 months; PREVIEW (suffix -preview) is more mature than experimental, not for production, has stricter limits and is shut down weeks or months after the stable version.

словарь_терминов.термин: deprecation / deprecated / shutdown / shut down / retirement / retirement date / legacy / previous generation
словарь_терминов.значение_en: Deprecation: announcement that a model is no longer supported and will be shut down; shutdown: the endpoint is completely turned off; retirement (date): the same on Vertex / Agent Platform, the last day of availability; legacy: an outdated model on its way out (said of Gemini 2.5 Flash Image); previous generation: models of the previous generation that are still active.
Dates in deprecation tables are a lower bound; the exact date is communicated in advance.
The replacement model named in shutdown tables.

словарь_терминов.термин: thinking / thinking_level / thinking level MINIMAL / HIGH
словарь_терминов.значение_en: Built-in reasoning before generation; image models have a reduced set of levels; the NB2 levels MINIMAL / HIGH appear in the Imagen replacement table.

словарь_терминов.термин: Grounding with Google Search / image-search grounding / image grounding
словарь_терминов.значение_en: Grounding generation on Google Search results (text and images); image grounding relies on images from search (Nano Banana 2 only).
A video (file or public YouTube URL) used as context for an image.
A response with text blocks and illustrations mixed together.
Separate (diffusion) text-to-image models, contrasted with Gemini native generation; now turned off or shut down.
The ID of 'Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview' in the Interactions API.
Service tiers and their prices.
Dedicated throughput on Vertex; quota enforcement windows.

словарь_терминов.термин: native image generation / native image output
словарь_терминов.значение_en: Image generation is performed by the Gemini model itself (2.0 Flash, 2.5 Flash).
The Gemini series to which the image models belong.
A stable model (Agent Platform) that can be shut down as early as 45 days after its replacement is released; Lite is marked this way.

словарь_терминов.термин: Search On / Thinking + Text Search + Image Search / Thinking – No thinking

Пары ядер ч1/ч2, похожие, но НЕ слитые (сомнение → связь «уточняет»): Я-модели-2 [ч1 1-2] ↔ Я-модели-3 [ч2 2-1] / Я-модели-4 [ч2 2-2]/Я-модели-5 [ч2 2-3]/Я-модели-6 [ч2 2-4] (общая таблица имён ч1 против поимённых ядер ч2 с основой модели); Я-модели-35 [ч2 2-14] ↔ Я-модели-36 [другое 1-6] (фактичность против инфографики); Я-модели-61 [ч1 1-29] ↔ Я-модели-62 [ч2 2-36] (free tier в cookbook против биллинга в Firebase); Я-модели-74 [ч1 1-45] ↔ Я-модели-75 [ч2 2-22] (процедура миграции против таблицы замен); Я-модели-48 [ч1 1-23] / Я-модели-24 [ч1 1-9] ↔ Я-модели-49 [ч2 2-35] (качество работы с рефами против числа картинок); Я-модели-17 [ч1 1-5] ↔ Я-модели-18 [ч2 2-16] (NB2 по умолчанию против «Pro-level at Flash speed»); Я-модели-25 [ч1 1-10] ↔ Я-модели-26 [ч2 2-19] / Я-модели-27 [ч2 2-10] (позиционирование 2.5 сейчас против запуска и сравнения с Pro 2025-11). У связей_с_другими_темами из ч2 и «другое» не было поля «тип»; при сшивке поставлено «уточняет» (с пометкой в пояснении). Проверить тип при шаге 3.

Слитое ядро Я-модели-22 [ч1 1-7] (+ Я-модели-22 [ч2 2-13]) получило класс/силу первичного ядра ч1 (параметр_вызова, рекомендация), а слитое ядро Я-модели-20 [ч2 2-12] (+ Я-модели-20 [ч1 1-6]) — класс/силу ядра ч2 (возможность_модели, факт), потому что лучший источник после слияния — карточка Agent Platform (E-261-1). сводка:
110 ядер на входе (ч1 — 50, ч2 — 49, из «другое» — 11) → 93 ядра. Слито 17 групп (34 старых кода): имя «Nano Banana», какие модели генерируют картинки, карта выбора модели, позиционирование Pro и Lite, текст в кадре, knowledge cutoff, thinking, Grounding with Google Search, разрешения, крайние соотношения, действующие id, судьба 2.5 Flash Image, замена 2.5 → Lite, снятие Imagen, текстоцентричные советы Gemini 3 (выведено), предшественник Gemini 2.0 Flash.
Части делили единицы без пересечений, поэтому слияние — по смыслу; продукт и API не сливались; при сомнении — связь «уточняет» и вопрос (имя↔id ч1 против поимённых ядер ч2, фактичность против инфографики, free tier против биллинга, процедура миграции Imagen против таблицы замен и др.).
Спор — 2 ядра: судьба gemini-2.5-flash-image в Gemini API (Я-модели-71) и число входных картинок у Lite (Я-модели-49). Спор ч2 о крайних соотношениях у Pro снят сшивкой по (в) данными ч1.
Сшивка добавила/дополнила противоречия: срок снятия stable Lite (а), задержка Lite (в), 512px у Lite (в, решение ч1 не изменилось), Firebase-даты preview Pro/NB2 и снятия 2.5 (версиями); пометка о 30.06.2026 у Imagen на Vertex.
Переведено на английский 575 строк (ситуация/не_применяется, тексты моделей → модели_различия, значения терминов, причины магнитов ч2/«другое», части ч1, оговорки со ссылками, 8 ячеек матриц) + 9 причин магнита для ядер ч1 (описаны по их отрицаниям); словарь сведён в 29 терминов с английскими значениями; модели приведены к да/нет/частично/не_сказано.
Я-модели-32 (исторический выбор Imagen / Gemini 2.5, 2025) — действует: false, заменено Я-модели-73. Хронологии, таблицы id, служебное и исходные матрицы/словари частей — в «дополнительно».
Сомнения: вход NB2 65k (skill-файл) против 131,072; замена Imagen 4 Ultra (flash по Gemini API против pro по Firebase); тип связей с другими темами без типа поставлен «уточняет»; класс/сила двух слитых ядер (Я-модели-20, Я-модели-22).
